
## Additional Model fit and diagnostics{-}

We tuned the model twice on two distinct subsamples of our data.  Two surprising results emerged. First, over the "Advanced" grid that we selected, the surface was relatively flat. Mean Brier scores ranged from a high of 0.199 (32, 1571) to a low of 0.178 (14,10), implying that the best pair of hyperparameters was 12\% better than the worst. A lower $mtry$ was preferred and once we get to a reasonably low level of $mtry$.  Second, our repeat tuning shows very similar results to the first one.

### Pre-calibration confusion matrix and aggregate predictions{-}


These are the predictions that come out of the non-calibrated models.

```{r no_cal_validations, eval=TRUE, results='hide', echo=FALSE}

aggregate_nocal_transactions<-nocal_predictions%>%
    summarise(across(c(starts_with(".pred_")), sum)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=starts_with(".pred_"), names_to="market_desc", names_prefix=".pred_",values_to="ObsPredicted")


aggregate_nocal_weight_predictions<-nocal_predictions %>%
    summarise(across(c(starts_with("pred_")), sum)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=starts_with("pred_"), names_to="market_desc", names_prefix="pred_",values_to="predicted")


true<-nocal_predictions%>%
    group_by(market_desc) %>%
    summarise(lndlb=sum(lndlb),
              transactions=sum(transactions))

nocalibrate_results<-aggregate_nocal_weight_predictions%>%
  left_join(true, by=join_by(market_desc==market_desc))

nocalibrate_results<-nocalibrate_results%>%
  left_join(aggregate_nocal_transactions, by=join_by(market_desc==market_desc))

nocalibrate_results<-nocalibrate_results%>%
  mutate(predicted=predicted/lbs_per_mt,
         lndlb=lndlb/lbs_per_mt) %>%
  rename(true_mt=lndlb,
         predicted_mt=predicted,
         predicted_transactions=ObsPredicted)%>%
  mutate(`mt error (%)`=percent((predicted_mt-true_mt)/true_mt, accuracy=0.01),
         `Transaction error (%)` = percent((predicted_transactions-transactions)/transactions, accuracy=0.01) )
  

transactions_nocalibrate_predictions<-nocalibrate_results %>%
  select(market_desc,transactions, predicted_transactions, `Transaction error (%)`)%>%
    mutate(
    predicted_transactions = comma(predicted_transactions, accuracy = 1),
    transactions = comma(transactions, accuracy = 1)                        
  )

weights_nocalibrate_predictions<-nocalibrate_results %>%
  select(market_desc,true_mt, predicted_mt, `mt error (%)`)%>%
    mutate(
    true_mt = comma(true_mt, accuracy =1),
    predicted_mt = comma(predicted_mt, accuracy = 1)                        
  )

```

) %>%

 column_spec(2:4, latex_column_spec = "r") %>%
